LanguageData.LP_FrostSlow.label: frost slowed
LanguageData.LP_FrostSlow.description: Frozen stiff by a winter wolf's icy bite; moving slowly.
LanguageData.LP_DisplacementPhantom.label: displacement phantom
LanguageData.LP_DisplacementPhantom.description: The displacer beast's image is always offset from where it really is. The next attack that would deal damage hits the phantom and misses completely; the phantom then vanishes for 6 seconds before reappearing. No longer works once downed.
